description: The machine-readable discovery document set for agents calling the OpenAgents decision API. Every document describes implemented behavior only; api-catalog.json's unimplemented list names advertised surfaces that do not exist. A deployed gateway serves this set at its origin — llms.txt, agents.md, auth.md, skills.md, the catalog, the OpenAPI fragment, and the generated agent card and skills index.

documents.content: llms.txt-convention entry point: the project one-liner and links to every discovery document.
The agent-facing entry document: what the service is, the order to read the discovery set in, and the honest limits.

Authentication contract: oak_ bearer keys via OPENAGENTS_API_KEY or a mode-0600 config file, sess_ session tokens on accounts deployments — including the oa_session cookie the member-scoped usage reads and dashboard accept — oak-mcp-http per-request bearer forwarding, workspace membership, anonymous access and the funded anonymous session lane, the typed refusal shape, which surfaces need no credential, and operator-side provisioning.

Versioned route catalog: every implemented route — including the public discovery documents and the /v1/docs corpus API — with method, path, request and response shape references, the complete refusal-code map, and an explicit unimplemented list.

OpenAPI 3.1 fragment covering exactly the implemented API routes — systemone, classify, the jobs family, models, the docs corpus API, balance, the account/workspace/billing families, the member-scoped usage reads, the dashboard, the skill-directory family, and healthz — with real request/response schemas and the documented refusal codes.
What an agent needs to call the API — the oak CLI, the oak-mcp and oak-mcp-http MCP servers, or raw HTTP — supported versions, and honest limits.
The tools/list snapshot the mirrored MCP server card serves; oak's test suite asserts it equals the live tool_list() output.
This file — the versioned index of the discovery document set.
General agent infrastructure: target architecture, the three layers, and what remains coding-specific. Predates this index and carries no version field.
Remaining design and implementation work for general agents. Predates this index and carries no version field.

served.content: The discovery home page — the document set with digests and links, HTML or JSON.

The versioned docs API — list/read/search/examples over the bundled corpus, no credential.
One entry per public document route.
Crawlers may read discovery; inference routes are disallowed.
The declarative Claude- and Codex-compatible plugin packages with manual installation instructions.
